summary: PROMPT 11.5 (Cron SLA + Inactividad + Resumen Diario) validated end-to-end. 96/96 pytest pass (9 in test_scheduler.py) + 7/7 new live API tests against the public ingress + full Playwright walkthrough of /admin/notificaciones cron panel. Backend, frontend, RBAC and Resend testing-mode behavior all conform to spec.
critical_code_review_comments: scheduler.py: clean singleton with idempotent start() and graceful shutdown(); CronTrigger + IntervalTrigger correctly used; coalesce=True+max_instances=1 prevents pile-up.

sla_inactivity.py: deduplication uses last timeline_event.created_at >= cutoff_iso — correct, prevents spam within the same window. R15 (waiting_*) and TERMINAL_TICKET_STATUSES filtered via $nin. tz-aware datetime helper handles both 'Z' and '+00:00'.
daily_summary.py: clean fallback chain supervisor → admin → no_recipient. compute_metrics returns all 7 KPIs as documented.

admin_cron.py: RBAC via require_min_role('admin') is properly applied; agent receives 403 (verified). on-demand POST scopes sla/inactivity/pulling to caller's tenant — sensible scoping for a multi-tenant build.

Minor: in admin_cron.py the unused import `ResourceNotFoundException` can be removed; the unknown-job path returns ErrorCode.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND but FastAPI Path Literal validation actually rejects with 422 first, so that branch is unreachable (cosmetic).

Resend production note: supervisor@myexcellence.local is NOT in the Resend testing allow-list, so daily_summary returns sent=false with the verbatim Resend reason — this is the documented behavior and matches main agent's note. For real prod, verify a domain in Resend.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (cron panel renders, 4 rows visible, all 4 Ejecutar buttons return 200 with expected JSON)

test_credentials: admin@myexcellence.local / Admin123! (used); agent@myexcellence.local / Admin123! (used for RBAC 403 check); supervisor@myexcellence.local / Admin123! (recipient, not exercised via login).
seed_data_creation: None at app level — all unit tests use ephemeral fixtures. Live API tests rely on the existing seeded `myexcellence` tenant. No persistent test data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PROMPT 11.5 fully green. Scheduler is alive in preview (CRON_ENABLED=1) with 4 jobs: sla_scan/inactivity_scan/pulling (interval 5m) and daily_summary (cron 09:00 UTC). Use /api/admin/cron/run/{job} for on-demand checks. The new live test file /app/tests/test_cron_live_api.py is a regression harness — keep it; it validates status, RBAC and the four force-run paths against the public URL. Resend testing-mode caveat is well-handled: daily_summary returns sent=false with reason verbatim from Resend when recipient is not the verified owner.
